buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Technical Specifications The cotton mattresses supplied by the firm shall strictly conform to the following specifications:

SSl No| Specification| Required Details 1| Type of Mattress| Premium Quality Cotton Mattress 2| Length| 190 cm 3| Width| 95 cm 4| Thickness| 10 cm minimum 5| Minimum Weight| 15 kg 6| Filling Material| 100% New, Clean and High-Quality White Cotton 7| Cotton Quality| Premium-grade carded cotton, free from dust, impurities and foreign materials 8| Filling Density| Uniform density throughout the mattress, without lumps or empty spaces 9| Odour & Toxicity| Free from unpleasant odour and harmful substances 10| Outer Cover| Premium Quality Heavy-Duty Cotton Drill Fabric 11| Fabric Standard| Conforming to applicable BIS specifications 12| Stitching Thread| High-strength white cotton sewing thread conforming to applicable IS standards 13| Stitching Quality| Strong, neat and durable stitching 14| Stitches per dm| 37–43 minimum 15| Quilting| Reinforced quilting throughout the mattress 16| Quilting Distance| Maximum 12 cm 17| Edge Finishing| Reinforced edges with durable stitching to prevent deformation 18| Shape Retention| Mattress shall retain its original shape and thickness during normal use 19| Departmental Logo| Not Required 20| Overall Quality| Premium quality, suitable for regular and long-term institutional use QUALITY ASSURANCE 1. The mattress shall be manufactured using 100% new cotton filling and premium-quality outer fabric. 2. Recycled cotton, waste cotton and inferior-quality filling materials shall not be accepted. 3. The mattress shall have uniform thickness, firmness and density throughout. 4. All stitching, quilting and edge finishing shall be strong and durable. 5. The mattress shall be free from manufacturing defects, stains, tears and unpleasant odour. 6. The purchaser reserves the right to inspect and reject mattresses that do not conform to the prescribed specifications. 2 WARRANTY The supplier shall provide a minimum warranty of 3 years against manufacturing defects, stitching failure and abnormal deformation under normal usage conditions. 3. Compliance with Technical Specifications The bidder shall ensure that the offered product strictly complies with all the technical specifications menti oned in the GeM bid and this ATC. Any deviation from the prescribed specifications may render the bid liab le for rejection. 4. Sample and Inspection The purchaser reserves the right to inspect the supplied mattresses to verify their quality, dimensions, wei ght and conformity with the prescribed specifications. Any mattress found defective or not conforming to the specifications shall be rejected and replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to the purchaser. 5. Documentary Evidence The bidder shall submit the following documents, wherever applicable: a. Manufacturer's authorization, if the bidder is not the manufacturer. b. Technical datasheet/product specifications of the offered mattress. c. BIS compliance certificate or relevant supporting documents for the materials specified in the bid. d. Undertaking confirming compliance with all the prescribed technical specifications.

6. Delivery The supplier shall deliver the complete quantity at the delivery location specified in the GeM contract withi n the stipulated delivery period. All expenses towards transportation, loading, unloading and delivery shall be borne by the supplier. 7. Acceptance and Payment Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory delivery, physical inspection and acceptance of the mat tresses by the consignee/competent authority, subject to the applicable GeM terms and conditions. 8. Rejection of Goods The purchaser reserves the right to reject any item which: - Does not conform to the prescribed technical specifications. - Is found damaged, defective or of inferior quality. - Does not meet the stipulated dimensions or minimum weight. - Contains used, recycled or substandard filling material. The rejected items shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional financial liability to the purchaser. 9. Acceptance of ATC Submission of a bid shall be deemed to constitute acceptance of all the terms and conditions stipulated in this ATC, in addition to the applicable GeM General Terms and Conditions (GTC) and bid conditions. .
